nodes.description: Context._msgSender: returns payable(msg.sender), the root source of caller-controlled input.
Stealth.transfer: public token transfer entry point, forwards to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Stealth.transferFrom: public allowance-based transfer, calls _transfer then _approve with subtracted allowance.
Stealth._transfer: core routing logic classifying buy/sell/transfer, enforcing tradingOpen, bot checks, cooldown and triggering swap/ETH payout.
Stealth._approve: private allowance writer validating non-zero owner/spender.
Stealth._transferFree: untaxed balance move between accounts.
Stealth._tokenTransferTaxed: wrapper dispatching to the taxed transfer path.
Stealth._transferTaxed: computes tax, deducts full amount, credits net amount, routes tax to contract.
Stealth._takeTeam: credits the collected tax to the contract balance.
Stealth._justTakingProfits: classifies a sell as >5% of holdings or not.
Stealth._getTaxedValue: integer arithmetic deriving the taxed token amount from the current tax rate.
Stealth._getTaxRate: time-based dynamic tax schedule depending on block.timestamp and first buy.
Stealth._getHours: pure helper converting timestamp delta to hours.
Stealth.swapTokensForEth: lockTheSwap-guarded swap of contract tokens for ETH through the router.
Stealth.manualswap: privileged manual swap of the full contract token balance.
Stealth.manualsend: privileged manual forwarding of contract ETH to the multisig wallet.
Stealth.airdrop: onlyOwner loop moving balances from the owner to many recipients.
Stealth.setMultipleBots: onlyOwner bulk blacklist of addresses.
Stealth.setBot: onlyOwner blacklists a single address (parameter typed address).
Stealth.deleteBot: onlyOwner removes an address from the blacklist.
Stealth.setAntiBotMode: onlyOwner toggles anti-bot front-running protection.
Stealth.excludeFromFee: onlyOwner fee exemption whitelist write.
Stealth.includeInFee: onlyOwner removal of fee exemption.
Stealth.setSellCoolDownTime: onlyOwner setter for the sell cooldown duration.
Stealth.updateRouter: onlyOwner replacement of router and pair addresses.
Stealth.sendETHToWallet: private ETH transfer to the multisig wallet.
Stealth.startTrading: onlyOwner one-shot opener that also arms anti-bot, swaps and records the start timestamp.
Stealth.setSwapEnabledMode: onlyOwner toggle of automatic contract swapping.
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner sets owner to the zero address.
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner ownership handover.
Ownable.lock: onlyOwner lock that zeroes owner and stores block.timestamp + time.
Ownable.unlock: restores the previous owner when block.timestamp passes the lock time.
Stealth.receive: payable fallback entered whenever ETH is sent to the contract (e.g. by the router swap).
Ownable.onlyOwner modifier: require(_owner == _msgSender()) gating privileged functions.
Stealth constructor: deploys the pair, sets the multisig and mints the whole supply.
mapping(address => uint256) private _balances: token balances.
mapping(address => uint256) private _firstBuy: first-acquisition timestamp used by the tax schedule.
mapping(address => uint256) private _lastBuy: last buy timestamp used by anti-bot checks.
mapping(address => uint256) private _lastSell: last sell timestamp.
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances: ERC20 allowances.
mapping(address => bool) private _isExcludedFromFee: fee whitelist also used as the taxed/untaxed switch in _transfer.
mapping(address => bool) private _hasTraded: per-address first trade flag.
mapping(address => bool) private bots: blacklist blocking transfers.
mapping(address => uint) private cooldown: anti-bot per-address sell cooldown.
uint256 public sellCoolDownTime: cooldown duration (default 60 seconds).
address payable private _stealthMultiSigWallet: ETH recipient and privileged caller.
IUniswapV2Router02 public uniswapV2Router: external router used for swaps.
address public uniswapV2Pair: liquidity pair used to classify buys/sells.
bool private tradingOpen: gate for all pair interactions.
bool private inSwap: reentrancy latch set by lockTheSwap.
bool private swapEnabled: enables automatic token->ETH conversion on sells.
bool private antiBotEnabled: enables timestamp based front-running protection.
uint256 private _tradingStartTimestamp: launch timestamp driving early tax rates.
uint256 private constant _tTotal: fixed total supply.
address payable private _owner: privileged owner used by onlyOwner and lock/unlock.
address payable private _previousOwner: owner stored during lock, restored by unlock.
uint256 private _lockTime: timestamp until which ownership is locked.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, privileges and transfer routing.
block.timestamp: miner-influenced time used for cooldowns, lock expiry and dynamic tax rates.
tx.origin: declared untrusted origin source, not referenced in this contract.
External call uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens with amountOutMin=0 and deadline=block.timestamp.
_stealthMultiSigWallet.transfer(amount): raw ETH push to a fixed address.
Owner-supplied arrays iterated with balance subtraction/addition in a loop.
Constructor external call to factory().createPair() against a hardcoded router.
Ownership state restoration in unlock gated only by block.timestamp against _lockTime.
Tax computation (transTokens * 10000 - numerator) / 10000 executed on user-controlled amounts.
address recipient of transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount).
uint256 amount of transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount).
address sender of transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount).
address recipient of transferFrom.
uint256 amount of transferFrom.
address from of _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 amount).
address to of _transfer; compared against uniswapV2Pair.
uint256 amount of _transfer, drives tax and profit classification.
uint256 sellAmount of _justTakingProfits.
address account of _getTaxRate, indexing _firstBuy.
uint256 tokenAmount passed to the router swap.
address[] _user recipient list of airdrop.
uint256[] _amount amounts of airdrop.
uint256 time added to block.timestamp in lock.
address payable newOwner of transferOwnership.
uint256 tTeam: taxed amount computed in _transferTaxed.
uint256 numHours: hour delta derived from block.timestamp in _getTaxRate.

edges.reason: _msgSender returns the caller supplied msg.sender address.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source account.
transferFrom spends the caller allowance via _msgSender().
onlyOwner authorises privileged calls by comparing _owner to msg.sender.
unlock requires _previousOwner == msg.sender to restore ownership.
manualswap accepts msg.sender equal to the multisig, contract or owner.
manualsend accepts msg.sender equal to the multisig, contract or owner.
airdrop debits and credits balances anchored on _msgSender().
_transfer records _firstBuy/_lastBuy/_lastSell and cooldown from block.timestamp.
_getTaxRate derives tax brackets from block.timestamp deltas.
_getHours consumes a timestamp as the range end.
lock stores _lockTime = block.timestamp + time, letting the miner influence the lock window.
unlock compares block.timestamp > _lockTime to release ownership.
startTrading snapshots block.timestamp into _tradingStartTimestamp.
transfer forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom forwards sender, recipient and amount into _transfer.
transferFrom reduces allowance through _approve.
Non-taxed branches of _transfer delegate to _transferFree.
Sell branch of _transfer delegates to _tokenTransferTaxed.
_transfer classifies the sell amount with _justTakingProfits.
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth with the full contract token balance.
_transfer forwards the contract ETH balance through sendETHToWallet.
_tokenTransferTaxed dispatches to _transferTaxed.
_transferTaxed asks _getTaxedValue for the tax amount.
_transferTaxed forwards the tax to _takeTeam.
_transferTaxed writes sender and recipient entries of _balances.
tTeam holds the taxed amount computed and consumed inside _transferTaxed.
_transferFree mutates _balances for sender and recipient.
_takeTeam credits the tax into _balances[address(this)].
_getTaxedValue obtains the current rate from _getTaxRate.
_getTaxRate measures intervals using _getHours.
numHours is the timestamp-derived hour count inside _getTaxRate.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap with amountOutMin=0 and no slippage protection.
the lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears the inSwap latch around the external swap.
swapTokensForEth reads the router and WETH addresses.
sendETHToWallet pushes ETH to the multisig address.
sendETHToWallet uses _stealthMultiSigWallet as the recipient.
manualsend forwards the contract balance through sendETHToWallet.
airdrop iterates owner-supplied arrays while mutating balances.
airdrop subtracts from and adds to _balances entries.
the constructor calls factory().createPair() on a hardcoded router.
unlock rewrites _owner/_previousOwner after only a timestamp check.
_getTaxedValue performs multiplications and divisions on user-controlled token amounts.
_transferTaxed subtracts the tax from the transfer amount before crediting.
onlyOwner gates airdrop.
onlyOwner gates setMultipleBots.
onlyOwner gates setBot.
onlyOwner gates deleteBot.
onlyOwner gates setAntiBotMode.
onlyOwner gates excludeFromFee.
onlyOwner gates includeInFee.
onlyOwner gates setSellCoolDownTime.
onlyOwner gates updateRouter, which can repoint the swap target.
onlyOwner gates startTrading.
onlyOwner gates setSwapEnabledMode.
onlyOwner gates renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner gates transferOwnership.
onlyOwner gates lock.
_transfer requires tradingOpen before any pair interaction.
_transfer branches on antiBotEnabled for cooldown enforcement.
_transfer branches on swapEnabled before swapping contract tokens.
_transfer uses _isExcludedFromFee to select the taxed or untaxed path.
_transfer reverts when bots[from] or bots[to] is set.
_transfer reads and writes the per-address cooldown mapping.
_transfer sets _hasTraded for first-time counterparties.
_transfer resets _firstBuy on large sells.
_transfer updates _lastBuy on sells and buys.
_transfer records _lastSell with the current timestamp.
_transfer compares from/to against uniswapV2Pair to classify the trade.
_transfer routes swapping through uniswapV2Router.
startTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
startTrading enables swapEnabled.
startTrading forces antiBotEnabled on.
startTrading stores _tradingStartTimestamp.
lock zeroes _owner to disable onlyOwner functions.
lock moves the current owner into _previousOwner.
lock writes the unlock deadline into _lockTime.
unlock restores _owner from _previousOwner.
unlock clears _previousOwner after restoring ownership.
updateRouter overwrites the router used for swaps.
updateRouter overwrites the pair used for trade classification.
setSwapEnabledMode toggles swapEnabled.
setAntiBotMode toggles antiBotEnabled.
setSellCoolDownTime overwrites sellCoolDownTime.
setBot sets bots[isbot] = true.
deleteBot sets bots[notbot] = false.
setMultipleBots writes the blacklist mapping in a loop.
excludeFromFee sets the exemption flag to true.
includeInFee clears the exemption flag.
the router swap can re-enter the swap entry path while inSwap is set but before balances settle.
the swap sends ETH to address(this), triggering the payable receive() fallback during execution.
ETH received through receive() can be routed onward into transfer logic.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is a plain argument of transfer and carries no independent semantics.
amount is only meaningful as the argument passed from transfer into _transfer.
sender is the allowance owner consumed by transferFrom.
recipient is a direct argument of transferFrom.
amount is used for both the allowance subtraction and the transfer.
from is the routing key compared against uniswapV2Pair inside _transfer.
to determines the buy, sell or plain transfer branch in _transfer.
amount drives profit classification and the taxed transfer value.
sellAmount is compared against the account balance to classify the sell.
account indexes _firstBuy to select the time based tax bracket.
tokenAmount is approved and forwarded to the router swap call.
_user supplies the transfer recipients of the airdrop loop.
_amount supplies the per-recipient credits inside airdrop.
time is added to block.timestamp to form _lockTime.
newOwner becomes the new _owner after validation.
tTeam is the intermediate tax value consumed immediately by _transferTaxed.
numHours is the transient timestamp delta used for bracket selection.
